protocol.feature_construction: saved E2 descriptors reused unchanged; some were derived from the full 250-specimen cohort, so only classifier fitting and scaling hold out donors
protocol.split: LeaveOneGroupOut; all donor scans; same splits for both descriptors
protocol.scaling: StandardScaler fitted on training specimens only
protocol.metric: binary balanced accuracy on each held-out donor
protocol.aggregation: unweighted mean of donor scores; each donor has equal weight
protocol.inference: descriptive only; no calibrated population p-values or intervals
